## Mixed genotypes Phasing

when AD is:

* 0/0, ./., 3/1 (supported by no reads or total number of reads < 5): use MAF in Bernoulli simulation
* 4/3 (#reads > 5 but 4 is not double of 3): use MAF in Bernoulli simulation
* 30/10, 12/25 (#reads > 5 and one is double of the other): use the most supported allele
